findings.evidence: Representable.lean:61 `abbrev CoordinateRing := Localization.Away (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℤ)` vs new `abbrev ChangeRing : Type _ := Localization.Away (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) B)`. `Universal.change := ⟨isUnit_coordinate_zero.unit, coordinate 1, coordinate 2, coordinate 3⟩` vs `universalChange B := ⟨(…algebraMap_isUnit (X 0)).unit, algebraMap _ _ (X 1), …⟩`. findings.fix: Keep one canonical API: set `Universal.CoordinateRing := ChangeRing ℤ`, `Universal.change := ChangeRing.universalChange ℤ`, `VariableChange.specialize C := ChangeRing.lift (Int.castRingHom R, C)`, and derive `Universal.ringHom_ext` from `ChangeRing.ringHom_ext` plus `RingHom.ext_int`. summary: The new general `ChangeRing B` API repeats, at `B = ℤ`, the existing `Universal.CoordinateRing` API (ring, universal change, its coordinate lemmas, evaluation hom, classifying lift, ext lemma), leaving two parallel APIs for the same object. One proof step also re-derives the definition of `rightUnit`.
